projects.description: a4agent (formerly a4api, from 0.4.0 onward) is an eight-platform AI coding tool management console and local LLM inference console. It provides unified skill management and MCP management for Claude Code, Codex, dsh (DeepSeek Harness), ZCode, pi, Qoder, OpenCode and WorkBuddy. It offers one-click provider switching for Claude Code and Codex, a built-in llama.cpp local model inference service, and headless task dispatch with phone and desktop notification reminders for seven of the platforms (all except WorkBuddy), all in one application. This article is the entry point to the documentation library. It outlines the project's positioning, feature overview, installation and quick start, and provides navigation to all feature documentation.
